questions.q: With reference to “Maharashtra govt orders 10% water cut from October 16 across state amid El Niño concerns”, consider the following statements:
items: Maharashtra Water Resources Minister Girish Mahajan has directed all urban local bodies to implement a minimum 10% water cut from October 16 amid concerns over limited water reserves and reduced rainfall linked to El Niño.
The Water Resources Department has undertaken dam-wise and usage-wise water planning up to August 31, 2027, with drinking water given the highest priority.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct.
